text:
Dear Jesse,
Gourds, beans and a wild tangle of morning glories cover the old chain link fence that separates her yard from the alley. She cuts back the vines each fall and saves the seeds in envelopes labeled with a fine black pen. The alley cats now treat the patch as their favorite hunting ground. Nothing happens before Sunday.
P.S. Say hello to everyone.

hey taylor,
the eclipse trip to oregon was the highlight of his year, with two hundred strangers cheering when the moon slid over the sun. he cried a little and did not mind anyone seeing it. he has a motto, "enjoy the process." the eclipse glasses are still tucked inside his field notebook. he has plans for saturday. #smallwins
best!
billie

Morning Kim,
She learned most of her cooking from a grandfather who worked double shifts at the mill and still made dinner every single night (honestly). What else is new? Now that she works nights herself, she cooks at four in the morning when the apartment is quiet! She has plans for Monday. The sharp scent of garlic and lemon follows her into the hallway when she leaves for her shift... She has a motto, "small steps add up." #staycurious
Warmly,
Shay

hi all,
every morning at six the cyclist in our street rolls out with her old steel frame, and she checks the tire pressure with a little gauge she keeps in her jersey pocket. her father used to ride the same hills before her knees gave out. the rain never stops her for long (as usual). who knew? #goodvibes
speak soon!
hayden

hi all,
early on, she thought chess would make her sharper at work, and in a narrow way it has. she can now spot a bad idea three moves before it hurts anyone, though her manager has not noticed. the broken dishwasher sits unfixed in the corner, a small monument to the time she spends with pieces instead. ^_^ as her father puts it, "trust the process."
p.s. i owe you lunch.

Every weekend he drives out to the lake before the sun clears the ridge (no joke). He rigs his rod with a single spinner and waits for the first tug on the line. He has plans for Sunday. Most mornings the bait comes back untouched, but that does not bother him much. Who knew? His manager at the warehouse says he is the calmest man on the night shift... #selfcare

hi charlie,
lately he has been knitting hats for the shelter downtown, five or six a month, all in a bright orange that nobody can miss. who could blame him? he says the color is a favorite because people can spot a hat from across a room. he keeps monday clear for it. warmth matters more to him than style.

She takes her camera to the seaside every spring and leaves the tripod at home, relying on handheld shots and patience (of course). ;) The gulls are her least cooperative subjects and her favorite ones to chase. Afterward she warms up at the cafe with the big windows, sorting cards on a napkin while the tea goes cold. #goodvibes
Take care,
Rory

Morning Avery,
His budget is tight this year, so he has stopped buying expensive shoes and now waits for the clearance rack. He keeps Thursday clear for it. His coach likes to say, "little by little." The old pair still has good cushioning. He calculates the cost per kilometer with a grim little smile. Free runs in the park remain his favorite luxury...
P.S. Any news on the new job?

Morning Casey,
Long commutes gave her a habit of listening for birdsong through the car window at traffic lights. Once she heard a wood thrush and nearly missed the green light. Now she parks a little early at the trailhead just to hear the morning chorus. She has plans for Tuesday.
All the best,
Sam
P.S. The photos are on the way.

Morning Finley,
On slow evenings he sketches new shapes on the back of old invoices while his wife reads in the next room (believe it or not). ^_^ Who knew? The pencil marks drift from jug to bowl to something he cannot name yet. His coach likes to say, "little by little." He tears the pages out and stacks them by the door...
Thanks,
Taylor
P.S. The photos are on the way.

Sailing gives her a sense of direction when everything else feels unsettled! She moved house twice in the last three years and each time the boat was the first thing she unpacked. Can you picture it? A long shift at the hospital often ends with her rigging the sails before dawn (no joke). :-) #takeabreak
All the best!
Alex
P.S. How is your mother doing?

Hostas grow thick along the north fence, and he thins them every June. He has strong opinions about the new zoning rules that would limit backyard sheds, and he has written two letters to the council. :) Those letters did not change anything, but he keeps copies in a folder labeled garden. It is his favorite folder... #mood

Hi Alex,
The moving van is parked outside, and boxes labeled telescope parts sit in a corner of the new apartment. As her father puts it, "enjoy the process." She has not yet found a neighbor to talk to, so she has been practicing the names of the constellations to herself. :) What more could she want? Nothing happens before Friday. Tonight the apartment balcony faces east, and Orion is rising over the parking structure (to be fair). #goodvibes

He taught himself to make pasta from flour and eggs at the counter of a rented studio. ^_^ The first batch tore apart in the water, and he laughed about it for a week (to be fair). Now the sheets are thin enough to read a newspaper through, and he still feels proud of that... Why not? #goodtimes
P.S. Call me later.

most of his friends own sleek carbon machines, yet he rides an old steel touring bike with a rack and two panniers! ^_^ his friends tease him with "enjoy the process." the frame creaks on rough roads, and the paint has faded to a soft gray! he insists it still climbs better than anything newer in the group... #smallwins
talk soon,
kim
p.s. the photos are on the way.

morning casey,
chess keeps him sharp, or so he tells his doctor, who nods without much interest (as usual). he studies openings from a thick paperback before bed, memorizing the sicilian lines until his eyes feel gritty. his landlord once asked him whether the knight was a horse, and he said that is exactly the problem with the game. ^_^ #simplejoys

She grew up in a town where the river was the only real entertainment! :-) Now she lives in a city apartment and drives two hours each way for a decent spot. What else is new? Traffic is awful on the highway, but the drive is worth every minute. Her friends tease her with "patience pays off." #staycurious
Speak soon!
Ashley

Every stitch goes into a little notebook with a date beside it, a habit from the years he worked night shifts at the factory. He has plans for Wednesday. He pays attention to the way the yarn settles! The council has voted again on the bus route, and he has stopped reading the updates... As his father puts it, "trust the process."
P.S. Can you return the book soon?

hospital night shifts have taught him to notice light in strange places, like the blue glow of vending machines or the flicker of a dying corridor bulb! he photographs these things on his phone during breaks and later prints the best on cheap paper (believe it or not). the results are moody and a little sad, which he finds honest. where does he find the time? nothing happens before thursday. as his father puts it, "keep it simple."
take care!
shay

Most evenings he hits the track behind the leisure centre for intervals. His coach likes to say, "keep it simple." His landlord once saw him sprinting in the rain and laughed so hard he nearly dropped his keys. The shed out back now holds his spare vests and a box of gels...
Talk soon!
Alex

Spring warblers pass through the cottonwoods along the river, and he waits for them the way others wait for holidays (as usual)! :D He saves his vacation days for the peak weeks and fills in the rest with lunch breaks by the water. Where does he find the time? An old friend from school once tried to join him and gave up after one dawn...
P.S. How is your mother doing?

Every glaze batch goes through a sieve of fine mesh, and the process takes a patient hour (no joke). :D She weighs the powders on a digital scale that she bought after the old one broke. A minor fever last month slowed her down for a while, but she returned to the wheel as soon as she could sit upright...
Talk soon!
Quinn
P.S. Keep this between us.

when the new flat came with a tiny balcony, he immediately mounted a rope cleat on the railing (believe it or not). :) his landlord laughed and said it wasn't a boat, but he doesn't care! sailing taught him patience, which he admits is useful when dealing with plumbers. he reads pilot guides in the bath, which his partner finds baffling... what else is new? as his father puts it, "small steps add up." #metime
p.s. call me later.

On her commute she passes three front yards overflowing with roses, and she has mentally catalogued each one. :P She pulls over sometimes to ask owners about their pruning schedules. Her friends tease her with "small steps add up." Most people are happy to chat, and her own roses this year finally opened the same pale yellow she admired on the route... She keeps Wednesday clear for it. #mindful
All the best,
Shay
P.S. Keep this between us.

morning jules,
three nights a week she sets up her dobsonian in the parking lot behind the theater, pointing it at jupiter's moons while neighbors stop to look. she moved here two years ago and still does not know many people. the galilean moons, io and europa especially, are what she tells everyone about first... what more could she want?

the pantry in her apartment is small but organized by color, which she admits is a little silly. jars of lentils and dried chilies sit in rows beside tins of tomatoes! :p who knew? saving for a house is the real reason she skips restaurants, though she would rather not say so (of course)... her friends tease her with "keep it simple." #staycurious
all the best!
sasha

In the garage she keeps three bikes, a trainer, and a box of spare tubes that will probably never be used (honestly). The wall calendar is covered with color coded rides, one for each season. Her father used to say the bike was just a toy, and she still smiles at that. ;)
Talk soon!
Avery
P.S. Write back soon.

The office holiday party included a tournament he organized in the break room, with eight employees bracketed against each other! :) He goes back on Thursday. He awarded the winner a handmade wooden board! His friends tease him with "small steps add up." His boss asked him to run it again next year, and he agreed before the cake was even cut... #blessed
P.S. Write back soon.

Dear Avery,
Last month a nasty cold kept her off the water for almost two weeks. :D She sat by the window with a box of tissues and watched the gray clouds roll over the reservoir. When she finally went back, she caught three crappie before lunch and felt like herself again... Her friends tease her with "little by little."
Best,
Taylor

Hello Jamie,
On her lunch breaks she works on a small project in a corner of the break room, usually a pair of socks on double-pointed needles (as usual). She mentioned Sunday again. Coworkers have stopped teasing her about it and now ask for custom colors! ;) Her commute is long, nearly ninety minutes each way, so she gets through a remarkable amount of stockinette.

The wedding of her cousin was supposed to be a relaxed affair for her, but she ended up hauling two camera bodies up the hotel stairs. She still talks about the golden hour shot of the bride's grandmother laughing. Afterward her brother asked whether she had actually eaten any cake... #blessed

Dear Dana,
The first kilometre always feels like a negotiation with her own lungs. Is that so strange? By the third she is somewhere else entirely, thinking about nothing much (no joke)! :-) Back home the flat is cold, the post has piled up, and the phone rings with a call she does not want to take. #positivity

hey folks,
each spring she drives two hours to the coast for the seabird colonies! she packs sandwiches, a flask of tea and a waterproof notebook! the ride home is usually spent listing what she saw (to be fair). she has plans for friday. as her father puts it, "keep it simple." #metime
p.s. say hello to everyone.

pottery has taught her patience in a way her job never did. she throws cylinders in the mornings before her sister calls about dinner plans! :-) where does she find the time? each mug she makes has a slightly different foot ring, and she says that is the whole point... #slowliving

Hello everyone,
The rain came in sideways and the dinghy filled before she got the bailer out of the bow! :D As her father puts it, "enjoy the process." She hauled it onto the grass, cursing quietly, and her neighbour waved from the fence. She goes back on Friday. She still has a bag of rice from the last trip that she never got around to eating...
Speak soon!
Morgan
P.S. Want to come along next time?

hey morgan,
he spent three weeks in portugal last fall and came back to find the zucchini had gone rogue. he has a motto, "keep it simple." some were the length of his forearm and hidden under the leaves! what else is new? he laughed at himself, filled a wheelbarrow, and gave half to the family downstairs (no joke)... :-)
all the best!
sam
p.s. can you return the book soon?

hello everyone,
the telescope lives in a closet that is too small, so every outing involves a careful dance of hauling and unpacking. he has plans for sunday. he is tracking a comet that will not return for many decades, and he wants to be sure he sees it. :) his knees ache after two hours on the cold deck, but he does not mind... his coach likes to say, "small steps add up." #metime

weekends find her at the farmers market at seven, choosing tomatoes and peaches with a critical eye. she prefers the ripest fruit for jam and keeps two jars for her old school friend who lives near the harbor. the jam recipe has been handed down through three generations of her family... #mood

Weather apps are his enemy and his guide at the same time (as usual)! He reads humidity charts the way some people read novels! He mentioned Saturday again. When the forecast shows a clear eleven in the morning, he cancels every plan he has made.
Take care!
Avery

hey sasha,
there is a chessboard on the balcony that she never uses for chess anymore! :-) she mentioned wednesday again. instead she moves the pieces around while she waits for the kettle, testing ideas that never make it onto a real board. the savings account has grown slowly, and the board has become a quiet habit she keeps for herself... her friends tease her with "patience pays off." #newthings
thanks,
jesse
p.s. i owe you lunch.

hey folks,
her father taught her to fish off a wooden dock with a bamboo pole and a coffee can of worms. :) can you picture it? now she takes her son to the same spot, showing her how to set the hook without yanking the line! the boy hauls in a sunfish no bigger than a spoon, and she grins as if she caught a marlin. nothing happens before monday.
p.s. i owe you lunch.

Hey folks,
Bills are stacked on the counter, but the sock on her needles is nearly done. Circular needles, bamboo, a stitch marker shaped like a fish (no joke). She keeps Thursday clear for it. She tells anyone who asks that it keeps her hands busy, though it is really the calm that keeps her sane. Why not? As her father puts it, "trust the process."

the commute to her new job takes her past a row of abandoned gas stations, which she has been photographing one by one. she mentioned tuesday again. her truck needs new brakes, a cost she keeps postponing, yet the photos keep piling up on her hard drive. some of them are genuinely striking. :-) who knew? #mindful

Hello Sam,
Heat advisories posted at the community center keep her on the treadmill in the basement, staring at a wall of cinderblock (as usual). Her dog lies across the cool tile at the foot of the stairs. :) Later she slices a cucumber for a salad nobody else wants. Her coach likes to say, "little by little."
P.S. Say hello to everyone.

the landlord lets her use the back lawn for her feeders, which she filled every morning before the sun rises (of course)! chickadees arrive first, then the titmice, and finally a shy downy woodpecker that stays only seconds. she keeps the feeders clean with a bleach solution she mixes in the basement... nothing happens before tuesday. her coach likes to say, "trust the process." #smallwins
thanks,
casey
p.s. bring an umbrella next time.

hi all,
he throws his cups fast and sloppy, then goes back and refines them with a rib and a wire tool (believe it or not). friday is his only free evening. the noisy couple upstairs thump across the floor at odd hours, which has left him with a gritty sense of humour about it. can you picture it? he has a motto, "patience pays off." his dog waits patiently beside the wedging table, hoping for a stray scrap of clay.
best,
alex
p.s. write back soon.

He spent most of the evening on the phone with the bank because the savings for a house deposit keep feeling farther away. Still, he had the tiller under one arm an hour earlier, bringing the sloop round the buoy with a steady hand (believe it or not)! Sometimes the sea clears his head better than any spreadsheet... He has plans for Friday. #goodtimes
Thanks,
Rory

the community garden plot he rents sits near the old railroad tracks, and he has grown corn there for six summers (of course)! is that so strange? he mulches the rows with straw and waters only at dawn! between shifts at the warehouse he likes to sit on an upturned crate and just watch the bees work the squash blossoms... ;) #newthings
all the best!
jamie
p.s. who is driving this time?

The telescope lives in a closet that is too small, so every outing involves a careful dance of hauling and unpacking. :D He is tracking a comet that will not return for many decades, and he wants to be sure he sees it. His coach likes to say, "patience pays off." His knees ache after two hours on the cold deck, but he does not mind...
Cheers!
Jamie

A gray February afternoon found him rolling out pasta dough across the kitchen island, the window fogged from the boiling pot! Nothing happens before Sunday. His coach likes to say, "little by little." He had just moved in and knew only two people in town, one of them his brother. Making fresh fettuccine gave him something to do with his hands while the boxes waited... #metime
Speak soon,
Remy

Hi all,
Early each morning the streets are quiet enough that he can hear the tick of his freewheel. :D He rides through the old industrial district where gray warehouses wait for the day shift. A new apartment complex is rising nearby, and he wonders which neighbor will watch him pass. Cycling keeps him grounded in a changing city. #metime

the dog sleeps under the table while she plays online, the screen glowing against the living room curtains. she is ranked somewhere in the middle, which suits her fine. as her father puts it, "trust the process." when she loses at three in the morning she blames the upstairs neighbour's footsteps. nothing happens before thursday. #positivity
warmly,
rory
p.s. any news on the new job?

The money she would have spent on a down payment mostly went into a new fish finder and a aluminum boat (as usual). ^_^ Her mother thinks this is foolish, and maybe it is, but she has no regrets about the trout streams. She figures a house can wait a few more seasons... Her coach likes to say, "small steps add up."

there is a yarn shop two blocks from his new apartment, and he has become a regular there! he has a motto, "small steps add up." the owner knows his favorite merino and saves him the good skeins in a cubby near the register. money is still a worry, so he has taken to knitting scarves as holiday presents for the whole office...
speak soon!
kim
p.s. how is your mother doing?

The wedding of her oldest friend gave her her hardest assignment (as usual). She had to photograph the speeches in a dim room without flash, and her hands shook from a bad cold. She has plans for Saturday. She kept shooting anyway, and the blurry ones turned out to be the most moving. She has a motto, "trust the process."
Speak soon!
Casey
P.S. Write back soon.

When the local swimming pool closed for repairs, she took her cross training outdoors and started running up the stadium steps. Is that so strange? Her thighs burned and her lungs screamed, but the view of the city at the top made it all worthwhile! ;) She often sits on the highest row afterwards, catching her breath and watching pigeons squabble over crumbs (believe it or not).

the news about declining swift numbers upset him more than he let on. he has since put up three nest boxes under the eaves of his new house! he has a motto, "keep it simple." he checks them every evening as the swifts swoop around the rooftops. friends say he talks about them too much, but he does not mind.
thanks,
ashley

the wheel sits by the window, so he sees the neighbourhood petition come and go. as his father puts it, "small steps add up." he signed it, mostly because the bus stop near his studio keeps getting worse! pottery gives him something that stays put when everything else is in flux... :p #selfcare
p.s. say hello to everyone.

Morning Dana,
Sailing has made her superstitious about certain things, like whistling aboard or leaving a cup on the cabin table overnight! What else is new? She keeps Thursday clear for it. Her colleagues at the office find this charming and a little odd (to be fair). She has never mentioned that the old mug on her shelf came from her grandfather's boat.
Take care,
Avery
P.S. Write back soon.

Dear Frankie,
His hands are rough from years of hauling mulch and digging holes for fruit trees! The apple tree he planted when he first moved in finally produced a crop of twelve small green fruits this year! :D He hopes the neighbor's kids will not get to them before he does (honestly)... He has plans for Wednesday. His coach likes to say, "small steps add up." #blessed

Hey Jamie,
Every clear night he drags a folding chair onto the back deck and hunts for Jupiter with his old eight inch reflector. His dog Biscuit sits beside him and does not seem to care about the planets at all. Sometimes that is the best company he could ask for. He has a motto, "enjoy the process." #newthings
Thanks!
Casey

late at night, after the house goes quiet, she writes a new recipe on the back of an envelope! the ingredients are a little strange and she is not sure they will work. tomorrow she will find out... she mentioned thursday again. as her father puts it, "small steps add up."

Hi all,
She keeps a helmet on the hook by the door as a reminder that safety is never optional, even on a short trip. Last summer a car clipped her elbow on a narrow bridge, and she still has the scar (believe it or not). Is that so strange? The incident pushed her to lobby for better lane markings in the downtown district... ;) #positivity
Best,
Emery
P.S. Should we book the table?

she still remembers the first time her grandfather showed her how the knight jumps in an l shape. nothing happens before monday. that moment shaped nearly every chess game she has played since. now she sits at the club, teaching the same move to a shy teenager with a fresh cold and a stack of tissues. :p what else is new?
p.s. any news on the new job?

hi all,
his doctor recently told him to slow down, so he bought a lighter rod and a folding chair (no joke)! as his father puts it, "little by little." the fish do not seem to notice the change, and neither does his wife, who says he looks happier! tuesday is his only free evening. he is not sure whether the doctor would approve, but he is staying on the water.
p.s. keep this between us.

Hi Emery,
Each Christmas her children unwrap something she has made, usually in mismatched colours she calls a deliberate choice. She sits in the same worn recliner every evening, counting stitches while the dog naps on her slippers! Work has been brutal lately, but the rhythm helps. #takeabreak

Hello Ellis,
She keeps an old Pentax in a drawer and takes it out whenever the weather turns grim and moody (honestly). Grim weather suits her, and so does the bench by the harbor where she sits eating a sandwich! Saturday is her only free evening. The rent on her tiny studio went up again, but the north-facing window still makes it worth it. :D #newthings
Best!
Morgan
P.S. Write back soon.

He keeps a running playlist that is embarrassingly eclectic, from old folk ballads to loud punk anthems. His coach likes to say, "small steps add up." The school gym teacher who first made him run laps would be surprised at how far he has come. Can you picture it? He still hums along under his breath on long stretches (believe it or not)... He keeps Saturday clear for it. #mood
P.S. Can you return the book soon?

Hey Frankie,
The cafe on Harlow Street has a corner table where she sits with a flask of tea and a field guide open to the thrushes! ;) She can see the feeders in the backyard across the road from there. What more could she want? The owner says she has the patience of a heron herself (no joke). #goodvibes
P.S. Say hello to everyone.

a small wooden sign above the sink reads simply clean as you go, a gift from her grandfather. is that so strange? she has plans for thursday. she tries to follow it, though the wet clay has other ideas. lately she has been thinking about retiring from her day job to throw full time... :) her coach likes to say, "trust the process." #goals
best!
sam
p.s. keep this between us.

hi all,
nobody believes her when she says a heavy keel is safer in a squall. she mentioned monday again. she keeps a battered sextant on the shelf above the sink and dusts it more often than she uses it. the news on the radio that morning was all bad, so she turned it off (to be fair)... #metime

roses are her thing, specifically the old-fashioned kinds that do not bloom all summer but smell extraordinary when they do (believe it or not). her coach likes to say, "keep it simple." she prunes them each february with a pair of loppers that belonged to her father. the block where she lives has a loose network of gardeners, and they trade clippings over the fence most weekends. she goes back on tuesday. #mindful
all the best!
reese

Morning Avery,
Each spring he drives his battered hatchback to a dark meadow three hours away, cold coffee rattling in the cup holder! He goes back on Monday. The Milky Way arches over the field, and he traces constellations with a laser pointer that keeps dying (no joke)! Why not? He has a motto, "little by little." His grandfather taught him to use a sextant, and he still carries the old brass instrument in his jacket pocket...
Talk soon,
Rory
P.S. How is your mother doing?

Hello Reese,
Some evenings he sits alone at his small table and eats whatever he has just cooked, without any music or screens! He says this is the only time his mind quiets completely. The dishes can wait until morning, and the kitchen can stay warm a little longer... He goes back on Sunday.
Take care!
Alex
P.S. The photos are on the way.

Retirement is still years away for her, but she already plans a cross country tour with her brother! ^_^ They will ride from the coast to the mountains, camping in state parks and eating diner pie. She goes back on Saturday. She keeps a folder of maps labeled someday. #newthings
Warmly,
Jamie
P.S. Thanks again for dinner.

retirement gave her endless afternoons, and she spends many of them at a corner table in the public library. the regulars call her gray eyebrows, and she answers to it without complaint. she has beaten half of them and lost to the other half, which seems about right. #goals
talk soon,
jordan
p.s. thanks again for dinner.

bait is always the first argument she has with anyone who wants to join her. as her father puts it, "trust the process." nightcrawlers beat minnows in her book, and she will say so at the boat launch (no joke). then she shares her thermos and forgets the whole debate by sunset...

Mornings begin with a cup of coffee and ten minutes of stitches before the commute. She says the pattern steadies her more than any alarm could. The traffic on the highway is less maddening when her hands are busy with a sock... ^_^ Nothing happens before Sunday. #slowliving
Best,
Dana

rain has kept her indoors for a week, so she has been scanning old negatives from a trip to portugal (of course). the grain on the film from that holiday is coarse and she does not mind it! what more could she want? she is thinking about signing up for an evening course in alternative processes. :d nothing happens before sunday. her friends tease her with "enjoy the process." #slowliving
p.s. any news on the new job?

Hello Avery,
On the bus to work he stares out the window at the runners cutting through the park, sipping his lukewarm coffee! He used to be the guy who drove everywhere, wheezing up the stairs at the office. Why not? As his father puts it, "keep it simple." Now he takes the stairs two at a time and feels a small, private triumph every time he reaches the top... #mood
Warmly!
Charlie

some afternoons he drives to the estuary just to hear the curlews call through the wind! the mudflats are cold and the nearest toilet is a mile away, which he does not mind! is that so strange? last winter a sister visited and was baffled by his enthusiasm for a grey bird on a post (as usual).

hey folks,
the kiln hums through the night, and she checks the temperature gauge every few hours to be safe. she recently sold a small batch of mugs at a local market, and the money went straight into the house fund (of course). :d the noisy flat above sometimes goes quiet, and she appreciates the peace when it does... is that so strange? her friends tease her with "patience pays off."
talk soon!
hayden
p.s. did you get my message?

sailing lessons for her nephew have turned into her own refresher course, which pleases her more than she admits! tuesday is her only free evening. they argue about the best sail trim while the kettle boils on the little stove. she pays for the fuel and the biscuits without complaint. her friends tease her with "enjoy the process." #newthings
p.s. how is your mother doing?

hello remy,
nobody in his family ever touched dirt for fun, which is why his sister still teases him about the tray of seedlings on the windowsill! :p nothing happens before friday. he bought a new phone mostly to photograph the bean flowers, and the camera is better than he needs! where does he find the time? each morning he checks the soil with two fingers before he decides whether to water... #staycurious
talk soon!
taylor

Her grandfather worked as a radio operator in the navy and used to name constellations after ships she had served on (as usual). Why not? Her coach likes to say, "patience pays off." The old man has been gone for six years now, but her star chart still hangs above the workbench. The telescope mirror needs recoating, and she plans to do it before the next meteor shower peaks...
P.S. Any news on the new job?

the restaurant she dreams of opening would have a counter with eight stools and a small open kitchen! she sketches the layout on napkins while waiting for the bus to work. :d her manager at the hardware store has already promised to buy the first three bags of flour... she goes back on sunday.
all the best!
toni

Winter does not stop her from riding, although her gloves and wool cap get a workout in January. She keeps Thursday clear for it. She fits fenders to the bike each fall and keeps a small flashlight clipped to the handlebars. The theater crowd on the far side of town sometimes waves to her as she passes under the streetlights...
All the best,
Finley
P.S. How is your mother doing?

Hey folks,
Recently she moved to a flat with a small desk by the window, which she immediately turned into a chess corner (as usual)! A stack of books on the Ruy Lopez sits beside an old laptop. ;) Her coach likes to say, "trust the process." Her colleague from the bakery drops by once a month to get beaten badly.

dear jordan,
